name: consignment-slip-editor
description: Consignment Slip Editor & Exporter packaged with Capacitor for Android

scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'), path = require('path'); fs.mkdirSync('www', { recursive: true }); if (fs.existsSync('index.html')) { fs.copyFileSync('index.html', path.join('www', 'index.html')); } else if (!fs.existsSync(path.join('www', 'index.html'))) { throw new Error('Missing index.html in root or www/'); }"
scripts.cap:add:android: npm run build && cap add android
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.cap:open:android: npm run build && cap open android
